questions.text: The atmosphere acts on a roof with a force of 20 MN. If the atmospheric pressure is 100 kPa, find the area of the roof (m²).
What pressure does a carpet of mass 4 kg and area 8 m² exert on the floor (Pa)?
A pump delivers oil to a hydraulic press at a pressure of 300 N/cm². If the cross-sectional area of the large piston is 900 cm², with what force does it act (kN)?
In the figure, three bricks are placed on a table in four positions. In which position do the bricks press on the table with the greater force?
answers: in all positions with the same force.

questions.text: A brick is placed on a table in 3 different positions as shown in the figure. In which position of the brick is its pressure on the table the greatest?
answers: the pressure is the same in all positions.

questions.text: How does the pressure of a given force on a circular surface change when the diameter increases by a factor of 2?

A building has several granite columns, each with a volume of 9 m³ and a base area of 1.4 m². The density of granite is 2800 kg/m³. What pressure (kPa) does one column exert on the foundation under its own weight?

Bodies hanging on a pulley are in equilibrium as shown in the figure. If the area of the part of the large load in contact with the table surface is 0.4 m², what pressure in Pa does it exert on the table? (M_large = 5 kg, m_small = 1 kg)
A force F = 120 N acts on an area S = 0.6 m² at an angle α = 37° to the vertical. Determine the pressure of this force (Pa).
A cube with an edge length of 2 m and a weight of 20 N rests on an inclined plane. Determine the pressure the body exerts on the surface of the inclined plane (Pa). (α = 53°)
Choose the correct statement of Pascal's law.
answers: External pressure exerted on liquids or gases is transmitted undiminished to all their points.
External pressure applied to all bodies in equilibrium is transmitted equally in all directions.
A body immersed in a liquid partially loses its weight.
The atmosphere presses on the earth because of its weight.

questions.text: Liquids and gases in a closed vessel transmit the external pressure applied to them ...
answers: in the direction of that pressure.
in the direction perpendicular to that pressure.
in the direction opposite to the acting force.

questions.text: ... external pressure is transmitted equally in all directions.
If we squeeze a ball with air trapped inside, where does the pressure increase more?
answers: in the direction of the force.
